slides.headline: Not just a farmhouse project.
slides.body: A way of life — 25 acres, with 3 given to a resort and clubhouse.

slides.headline: Edible landscaped backyards
slides.body: Your own food forest — fruit, vegetables, herbs.

slides.headline: Premium resort & clubhouse
slides.body: Three of the twenty-five acres, kept for stillness.

slides.headline: Strategic location
slides.body: Narsapur, adjacent to the upcoming Regional Ring Road.

slides.headline: Built by hand, from the earth up
Earth blocks, laid by hand
slides.body: The ground the house stands on becomes the house.

slides.headline: Bamboo, bent and lashed
slides.body: No steel frame. A grid shell, tied by hand.

slides.headline: Thatch, layered roof by roof
slides.body: Laid in courses, the way it has always been laid.

slides.headline: Then it becomes a home.
slides.body: Cool in the heat. Quiet in the rain. Made of the place it stands in.

slides.headline: Inside
slides.body: Earth plaster, shaped and burnished by hand.

slides.headline:
Own a Holiday.
Earn a Future.
Live in Peace.
A retreat that pays you back.
slides.body: Your holiday home isn't just a retreat — it's a living, breathing investment.

slides.headline: Somewhere that works
slides.body: Rented and managed when you're away.
